title: Heritage Atelier Editions
license_policy: Original source terms remain applicable to derived models; Atelier is a collection, not a license classification

editions.name: Wayfarer Oak
details: Secondary UV wood/enamel normal finishing
Source base-color atlases and UVs preserved
Scored board joints and fine brushed-metal normal maps
Authored layered edge rails, corner shoes, domed fasteners and physical rear hinges on the acquired source shell.
Side handle backplates are fitted by raycast to the actual body; rolled handles include mounting bolts and a hinge pin.
Curved lid band inlays are sampled from source lid geometry and follow the real Lid pivot.
Authored hardware is joined into separate rigid Body and Lid batches, preserving source shell meshes and material slots.
Theme-specific crafted trim: wayfarer-oak.
Brown wood and silvery iron identity retained; no palette-only duplicate source shell
Fitted source-connected KayKit keyplate with moving tongue and fixed receiver; KayKit original clasp retained on its own shell
Source wood grain and secondary normal detail baked into the optimized runtime atlas
editions.animation_authorship: New rigid Lid hinge Open and Close clips, 61 sampled keys over one second; acquired source clips not reused
